translations.home.hero.pill: For online stores, dropshippers & small brands
translations.home.hero.title: Turn more of your visitors into {$START_TAG_SPAN}buyers.{$CLOSE_TAG_SPAN}
translations.home.hero.lead: Put on-brand offers, signup forms and promo banners on any website in minutes. Design them visually, publish with a click, and see what actually sells.
translations.home.hero.note: Free plan · No credit card needed
translations.home.audience.stores.title: Online stores
translations.home.audience.stores.body: Launch a discount, a free-shipping bar or a bundle offer the moment you think of it.
translations.home.audience.dropshippers.title: Dropshippers
translations.home.audience.dropshippers.body: Test a new offer on every product page in minutes and keep the one that converts.
translations.home.audience.local.title: Local businesses
translations.home.audience.local.body: Collect bookings, callbacks and enquiries straight from the site you already have.
translations.home.audience.brands.title: Small brands
translations.home.audience.brands.body: Grow your list with signup forms that look like your brand, not like a plugin.
translations.home.steps.design.title: Design
translations.home.steps.design.body: Pick an offer or form, then drag, drop and restyle it in a visual editor. Your colours and fonts come along automatically.
translations.home.steps.publish.title: Publish
translations.home.steps.publish.body: Paste one snippet into your site once. Every change after that goes live with a click — no redeploy, no developer.
translations.home.steps.measure.title: Measure
translations.home.steps.measure.body: See views, clicks and submissions per widget, and get notified when a new lead comes in.
translations.home.benefits.noDev.title: No developer time
translations.home.benefits.noDev.body: Build and change offers yourself. The only technical step is pasting one line of code, once.
translations.home.benefits.onBrand.title: On-brand by default
translations.home.benefits.onBrand.body: Widgets pick up your colours, type and corner style, so they look like part of your store.
translations.home.benefits.isolation.title: Never clashes with your site
translations.home.benefits.isolation.body: Every widget runs in its own isolated Shadow DOM — your theme’s CSS can’t break it, and it can’t break your theme.
translations.home.benefits.rollback.title: History and instant rollback
translations.home.benefits.rollback.body: Every save becomes a version. Went live with a typo? Roll back to the previous version in one click.
translations.home.benefits.analytics.title: Analytics and notifications
translations.home.benefits.analytics.body: Know which offer people actually click, and hear about new submissions as they happen.
translations.home.useCases.lead.title: Lead capture forms
translations.home.useCases.lead.body: Callbacks, quotes and enquiries, delivered to your inbox.
translations.home.useCases.promo.title: Promo banners
translations.home.useCases.promo.body: Sales, coupon codes and free-shipping thresholds.
translations.home.useCases.news.title: Newsletter signup
translations.home.useCases.news.body: Grow your list with a form that matches your brand.
translations.home.useCases.feedback.title: Feedback widgets
translations.home.useCases.feedback.body: Ask one quick question and learn why people don’t buy.
translations.home.faq.developer.a: No. You design everything in the visual editor. The only technical step is pasting one snippet into your site, once — most store builders have a box for exactly that.
translations.home.faq.compat.q: Will it work on my website?
translations.home.faq.compat.a: If you can add a snippet of code to your site, it works — hosted store builders, WordPress and hand-built sites alike.
translations.home.faq.speed.q: Will a widget slow down or break my site?
translations.home.faq.speed.a: Widgets load after your page and run inside their own Shadow DOM, so your theme’s styles can’t leak in and theirs can’t leak out.
translations.home.faq.free.q: What does the Free plan include?
translations.home.faq.free.a: One live widget, 10,000 widget views a month and 10 saved versions per widget. No credit card is needed to sign up.
translations.home.faq.mistake.q: What if I publish a mistake?
translations.home.faq.mistake.a: Your saves are kept as versions — 10 per widget on the Free plan. Roll back to any of them with one click and it’s live again straight away.
translations.home.faq.reward.q: How does the idea reward work?
translations.home.faq.reward.a: Suggest a feature. If we build it and it ships as part of a paid plan, it’s unlocked on your account for free, on any plan, for as long as your account is active. Ideas that ship to every plan reach you anyway — you get a thank-you. Plan limits such as widget counts are never unlocked this way.
